title: Mission config
description: A mission config file named by a mission manifest's `config`: the teams, alliances and options the mission starts with.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: Path or URL of the JSON Schema for this file, for editor autocomplete and errors. The client ignores it.

alliances.title: Alliances
alliances.description: Every alliance in the mission, keyed by name, with the teams in it. Names use letters, digits and underscores only.

^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.title: Teams
^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.description: The teams in this alliance. Each team belongs to one alliance.

items.title: Team
items.description: A team named in `alliances`. Names use letters, digits and underscores only.

playerTeam.title: Player teams
playerTeam.description: Teams for the human players, assigned in the order players are in the lobby.

items.title: Team
items.description: A team named in `alliances`. Names use letters, digits and underscores only.

startPosType.title: Start position type
startPosType.description: How start positions are picked: fixed, random, in-game or in-client.

allianceSettings.title: Alliance settings
allianceSettings.description: Settings per alliance, keyed by a name in `alliances`. Names use letters, digits and underscores only.

alliedWith.title: Allied with
alliedWith.description: An alliance named in `alliances` that this alliance is allied with. Names use letters, digits and underscores only.

startRectTop.title: Start box top
startRectTop.description: Edge of the start box, as a fraction of the map size from 0 to 1.

startRectLeft.title: Start box left
startRectLeft.description: Edge of the start box, as a fraction of the map size from 0 to 1.

startRectBottom.title: Start box bottom
startRectBottom.description: Edge of the start box, as a fraction of the map size from 0 to 1.

startRectRight.title: Start box right
startRectRight.description: Edge of the start box, as a fraction of the map size from 0 to 1.

teamSettings.title: Team settings
teamSettings.description: Settings per team, keyed by a team in `alliances`. Names use letters, digits and underscores only.

^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.title: Team settings
^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$.description: Settings for one team. Other startscript team settings may be added too.

side.title: Side
side.description: Faction the team plays, such as Armada.

incomeMultiplier.title: Income multiplier
incomeMultiplier.description: Multiplier on the team's resource income.

startPosX.title: Start X
startPosX.description: Start position on the map's X axis, in elmos.

startPosZ.title: Start Z
startPosZ.description: Start position on the map's Z axis, in elmos.

luaAI.title: Lua AI
luaAI.description: Lua AI that controls the team, such as BarbAI.

restrictions.title: Unit restrictions
restrictions.description: Build limits keyed by unit name.

^(.*)$.title: Limit
^(.*)$.description: The most of this unit a team may build. 0 disables it.

modOptions.title: Game options
modOptions.description: Game mod options keyed by option key.

mapOptions.title: Map options
mapOptions.description: Map options keyed by option key.
